reviewStatus: Drafted from verified sources; pending independent clinician review before clinical release.
commonErrors: Using patient-reported rather than clinician-assessed status without noting it.
name: ECOG Performance Status
purpose: Describes functional performance in patients with cancer.

options.label: 1: Restricted in strenuous activity; ambulatory and able to do light or sedentary work
2: Ambulatory and capable of self-care; unable to work; up and about more than 50% of waking hours
3: Limited self-care; confined to bed or chair more than 50% of waking hours
4: Completely disabled; no self-care; confined to bed or chair

resultStates.label: ECOG 1
resultStates.summary: Restricted in strenuous activity; ambulatory and able to do light or sedentary work.

resultStates.label: ECOG 2
resultStates.summary: Ambulatory and capable of self-care; unable to work; up and about more than 50% of waking hours.

resultStates.label: ECOG 3
resultStates.summary: Limited self-care; confined to bed or chair more than 50% of waking hours.

resultStates.label: ECOG 4
resultStates.summary: Completely disabled; no self-care; confined to bed or chair.

clinicalContext.text: The most widely used performance scale in oncology trials.

clinicalInsights.text: KPS is an alternative; conversions are approximate.

limitations.text: Subjective, with inter-rater variability, particularly between grades 1 and 2.

guideSections.howToPerform: Select the grade that best matches current function.

sources.citation: Oken MM, Creech RH, Tormey DC, et al. Toxicity and response criteria of the Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group. Am J Clin Oncol. 1982;5(6):649-655.
